title: Studies: residence permit
quote: For a study residence permit, IGI says to submit the documents at least 30 days before the visa-granted stay expires. The listed student documents include an application, passport, enrolment certificate, proof of funds and housing, medical certificate and fees. Check the applicable category and current list with IGI.
action: Ask the territorial IGI office which residence procedure and documents apply to your nationality and status.
fields: Date of last entry in Romania

title: Learning Agreement for Studies: KA131 guidelines
quote: For KA131 long-term mobility, the guidelines describe exceptional programme changes: the student can initiate them within five weeks of each semester start, and all parties should agree within two weeks of the request. Changes go in the relevant change tables, without changing the original tables.
action: Ask both universities which learning agreement applies, then prepare course changes for their review.

title: Erasmus+ Student Charter
quote: The Erasmus+ Student Charter says students should ensure health insurance coverage for their stay abroad, following information and guidance from their higher education institution.
action: Ask your university and insurer what coverage and proof are accepted for your circumstances.
